_comment: Intake form section 3's 'ما يجب تجنبه' plus section 6's 'بيانات لا يجوز نشرها'. This file is the record of what must NOT appear in published copy, and why. It is read by /admin/exclusions and mirrored by the banned-phrase rules in lib/verification.ts and scripts/check-publish-gate.mjs. `override` stays false unless the client overrides in writing; the neverPublished list below cannot be overridden at all.
_comment_no_nl: THE `reason` FIELDS HERE ARE THE ONLY LOCALIZED OBJECTS IN data/ WITH NO `nl` VALUE, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE RATHER THAN AN OVERSIGHT. Dutch was added as a third site locale and every other localized field in every other data file carries it. These do not, because nothing here is ever rendered to a visitor: this file is an internal compliance record, it has no public surface, and it is in the INTERNAL_FILES skip list in scripts/check-publish-gate.mjs for the same reason. Several of these reasons quote the Arabic intake form verbatim, and their value is that exactness, so a third paraphrase would add a way for the record to drift without adding a reader. If this file ever gains a public surface, translate them then.

items.item: Figures, percentages or growth claims that are not documented

reason.en: Section 3: 'وأي عبارات مبالغة أو أرقام ونِسب غير موثقة'. Section 4 adds that no figures exist that can be published and verified at this stage. A number on a profile page reads as audited whether or not it is.
reason.ar: القسم 3: «وأي عبارات مبالغة أو أرقام ونِسب غير موثقة». والقسم 4 يضيف أنه لا توجد أرقام قابلة للنشر والتحقق في هذه المرحلة. والرقم على صفحة تعريفية يُقرأ كأنه مدقق سواء كان كذلك أم لا.

items.item: Names of clients, or of partner companies before they are approved

reason.en: Section 3: 'وأي إشارة إلى قيم صفقات أو أسماء عملاء'. Section 6 repeats it for partners. The two ventures she is a partner in are held at publish:false in data/positions.json until the names arrive in writing.
reason.ar: القسم 3: «وأي إشارة إلى قيم صفقات أو أسماء عملاء». ويكرر القسم 6 ذلك بشأن الشركاء. والمشروعان اللذان هي شريكة فيهما محجوبان في data/positions.json حتى ترد الأسماء كتابيًا.

items.item: Transaction values, commissions or any financial figure

reason.en: Section 6: 'وأي تفاصيل صفقات وقيم مالية'. A profile that quotes deal sizes invites being read as a solicitation, which the terms page expressly disclaims.
reason.ar: القسم 6: «وأي تفاصيل صفقات وقيم مالية». والملف الذي يذكر أحجام الصفقات يُقرأ كأنه عرض، وهو ما تنفيه صفحة الشروط صراحةً.

items.item: Advertising or promotional register, and loud visual treatment

reason.en: Section 3: 'تجنّب الأسلوب الترويجي أو الإعلاني، والألوان الصارخة، والعناصر الحركية الزائدة'. The requested character is 'رسمي · قيادي', formal and leadership-facing.
reason.ar: القسم 3: «تجنّب الأسلوب الترويجي أو الإعلاني، والألوان الصارخة، والعناصر الحركية الزائدة». والطابع المطلوب «رسمي · قيادي».

items._comment_override: PARTIAL OVERRIDE, MOTION CLAUSE ONLY, 2026-09-14, SCOPE WIDENED 2026-09-15, WIDENED AGAIN 2026-09-15 (fourth pass). The site owner directed a scroll-linked motion layer after being shown this exclusion in full. That is the 'العناصر الحركية الزائدة' clause and it is the ONLY clause overridden. The other two clauses of section 3 stand and are unaffected: the promotional/advertising register is still banned (enforced by scripts/check-publish-gate.mjs, which this override does not touch), and 'الألوان الصارخة' still holds, the gold remains confined to hairline rules, eyebrows, margin marks and one filled CTA per view, and no colour value in styles/globals.css changed. NOT A WRITTEN CLIENT OVERRIDE: the file header above requires one, and this is not it. The direction came from the site owner during the build, not from Sanae in writing, so this entry must be put to her at sign-off IN FULL, using the itemised list in _comment_override_scope below, not this summary, and reverted if she declines.
items._comment_override_scope: WHAT IS ACTUALLY BUILT, as of 2026-09-15. The 2026-09-14 entry described four effects (portrait drift, a roles progress rail, scroll-reactive numerals, a band tone wash). The owner then directed a second, larger pass, ten effects on the home page, built on Framer Motion's React bindings in components/motion/fm/. This list supersedes the earlier four and is what must be shown at sign-off, because approving the original wording would not be informed consent to what now ships. Home page: (1) the portrait recedes in 3D as the hero scrolls away, absorbing the original drift; (2) the expertise margin marks draw and un-draw with reading position; (3) the expertise list shears up to 1.6° with scroll velocity; (4) the band wash's radial centre travels across each band as well as brightening; (5) the hero role line crossfades on a width spring; (6) the roles reading rail is spring-led with a velocity-reactive head; (7) section headings are uncovered by a sweeping mask; (8) the working-together statement column pins while its rows lift past it; (9) the expertise cards tilt toward the pointer. EVERY ONE settles rather than looping, is gated on prefers-reduced-motion, and degrades to the static page. Nothing tracks the pointer except (9), which decorates a real control. No text is ever split, scripts/check-publish-gate.mjs now enforces that rather than leaving it to documentation. THE ONE TO FLAG EXPLICITLY at sign-off is (9): components/motion/interactions.ts records three pointer-tracked effects that were DELETED from this site on register grounds, and a pointer-reactive card re-opens that decision. THIRD PASS, 2026-09-15, REVERSIBLE SCROLL MOTION, SITE-WIDE. The owner then directed that motion apply to everything and respond to scrolling in BOTH directions. This supersedes the nine effects above as the list to show at sign-off. What changed: (10) entrance animations on the contact form and the inner-page bands are no longer fire-once, they are tied to scroll POSITION, so they resolve as the reader descends and un-resolve as they scroll back up; (11) every dedicated page (about, expertise, roles, contact) now carries the band tone wash and a 3D recession on its opening band, which the home page already had and they did not; (12) the contact form's fields cascade in on that same reversible scrub. THE ONE MATERIAL CHANGE IN CHARACTER is (10): until now every entrance on this site played once and settled, and the page was still while the reader read. It no longer is, content near the edges of the viewport moves whenever the reader scrolls, in either direction. That is a larger departure from «رسمي · قيادي» than any single effect above, and it is the thing to put to her first. Content is never caught mid-fade while being read (each reveal is fully resolved across the middle of its window, verified in-browser), reduced-motion and no-JS both render the finished static page, and the footer was deliberately LEFT on a fire-once entrance because a page-terminal element cannot complete a scroll window. FOURTH PASS, 2026-09-15, MOTION ON EVERY SURFACE. The owner then directed that all fifty suggested effects be applied and that the whole application be animated. This supersedes the third-pass list as the one to show at sign-off. What changed, and the first two are the material ones: (13) THE THREE LEGAL PAGES (privacy, terms, cookies) NOW ANIMATE. They were the last still surfaces on the site and were deliberately so, they are the pages a reader goes to for a definite answer about data handling, and motion on a privacy notice is the least appropriate place for it on the whole site. Their reveals are the quietest built (opacity floor 0.4, resolved by 32-40% of cover) and are CSS-only, so the pages remain server components shipping no JavaScript; (14) ROUTE TRANSITIONS via @view-transition, the outgoing page recedes and the incoming advances, so navigation itself is now animated rather than instantaneous, which affects every route including the legal ones; (15) the document grain now appears only while scrolling and fades at rest, replacing the static layer; (16) the expertise grid's gap and the ledger rail's weight react to scroll velocity; (17) section snapping changed from mandatory to proximity so it eases rather than locks; (18) entrance reveals on cards, panels, figures, rules, marks, form fields and legal paragraphs throughout. WHAT WAS REQUESTED AND DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT: three of the fifty required splitting text into per-word or per-letter fragments (a per-word quote settle, two letter staggers). scripts/check-publish-gate.mjs bans splitText and intake section 6 requires names render intact, so they were not built and no workaround was attempted. NO COLOUR VALUE CHANGED in this pass: the `الألوان الصارخة` clause is untouched, every rule animates transform, opacity, clip-path or filter, and the gold remains confined to hairlines, eyebrows, margin marks and one filled CTA per view. Every effect settles, none loops, none tracks the pointer, all are gated on prefers-reduced-motion, and all degrade to the finished static page in browsers without scroll-driven animation support.
